result: Lookahead runs any inner optimizer for k fast steps, then moves the slow weights a fraction α towards the result. On the noisy quadratic its steady-state variance is strictly below SGD's at the same learning rate (Prop. 2), and in practice it makes training more robust to hyperparameters.
result_plain: k fast steps, then slow weights interpolate; lower stationary variance than SGD at the same learning rate.
